fact: The party arrives at Neverlight Grove on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of the 29th year (029.05).
subject: session date

fact: The party travels for several days to reach Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: After days of travel, the party arrives at the bioluminescent mushroom forest
subject: travel duration

fact: Neverlight Grove is a vast cavern with bioluminescent mushrooms covering the floor, ceiling, and surrounding surfaces.
source_quote: bioluminescent mushrooms covered every surface, floor to ceiling
subject: Neverlight Grove structure

fact: The party enters Neverlight Grove through a natural tunnel that is the only passage fit for easy travel.
source_quote: The tunnel is the only passage fit for easy travel; the others are narrow fissures.
subject: Neverlight Grove passage

fact: There are two sovereigns of the grove: Phylo and Basidia.
source_quote: The two sovereigns of the grove, Phylo and Basidia
subject: sovereigns count

fact: Phylo refers to the Great Seeder using gendered pronouns ('she', 'her'), which is unusual for myconids who have no gender.
source_quote: He praised a figure called the 'Great Seeder' ... kept calling the entity 'she' and 'her'
subject: Phylo

fact: A previous group of 'softers' was taken to the Garden of Welcome and has not been seen since.
source_quote: A previous group of 'softers' had accepted Phylo's hospitality and been taken to the Garden of Welcome. She had not seen them since
subject: previous softer group

fact: The Circle of Masters cannot be visited by the party until the following day.
source_quote: the Circle of Masters will only be visited the following day
subject: Circle of Masters availability

fact: Daz rolls a 12 on an Arcana/Nature check, which improves to 23 with help.
source_quote: Daz's Arcana/Nature check comes to 12, and 23 with help
subject: Daz ability check

fact: Gyrgum rolls an 18 on an insight check, noticing Basidia's discomfort.
source_quote: Gyrgum's insight check of 18 catches Basidia looking uncomfortable at Phylo
subject: Gyrgum insight check
